rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something portable or designed to be used while held in the hand.

example.english: This hand-held laptop is really light.
example.jyutping: nei1 bou6 sau2 tai4 din6 nou5 hou2 heng1

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the object is physically being held, rather than merely being portable.

example.english: This bag is being hand-held, so I can't put it down.
example.traditional: 呢個袋係用手拎住嘅，我唔可以放低佢。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 doi6 hai6 jung6 sau2 ling1 zyu6 ge3 ngo5 m4 ho2 ji5 fong3 dai1 keoi5
